shared_apple_api.reason: Exact shared Apple API spellings are producer-owned; they are not Tera declarations.
shared_apple_api.reader: Tera Swift adapters, custody/media/lifecycle integrations and their tests
shared_apple_api.removal_condition: Only with an explicit shared Apple API migration and verified consumers; never a cosmetic application rename.

shared_foundation_api.reason: Published crate, protocol, DTO, manifest and source-lock identifiers remain shared contracts.
shared_foundation_api.reader: Tera Rust/FFI adapters, source/graph verifiers and generated artifact readers
shared_foundation_api.removal_condition: Only with an explicit shared producer contract revision and compatibility verification at its consuming boundary.

public_namespace.owner: Public Radroots repositories and protocol namespace
public_namespace.reason: The public organization/domain, registered URL scheme and shared SDK namespace retain their identity.
public_namespace.reader: Exact source-lock consumers, endpoint configuration, native deep-link readers and namespace guards
public_namespace.removal_condition: Only through a reviewed public identity or protocol migration that preserves installed readers and exact source ownership.

installed_identity.owner: Existing Apple installation and credential boundary
installed_identity.reason: Bundle and Keychain namespaces identify existing installations and credentials.
installed_identity.reader: Tera configuration, Apple credential lookup and frozen compatibility tests
installed_identity.removal_condition: Retain unless an explicitly approved migration proves old installations and credentials remain readable.

persisted_data.owner: Existing application persistence and signed-operation formats
persisted_data.reason: Stored keys, filenames, schema/cursor/hash domains and diagnostic document schemas retain their old bytes.
persisted_data.reader: Tera persistence/migration readers, projection and operation-ID derivation, existing diagnostic document readers
persisted_data.removal_condition: Only with explicit versioned readers and upgrade/restart tests preserving pending operation identity; never a branding replacement.

native_ui_contract.owner: Existing native navigation and accessibility contract
native_ui_contract.reason: Current URL/action/accessibility identifiers remain stable across the application rename.
native_ui_contract.reader: Tera navigation, UI automation and accessibility consumers
native_ui_contract.removal_condition: Only through a coordinated control/reader migration with all affected navigation and accessibility tests.

verification_compatibility.owner: Existing fixture, result and development command contracts
verification_compatibility.reason: Synthetic namespaces, result filenames/hash domains, ratchet schemas and device output paths retain their existing readers.
verification_compatibility.reader: Native/Rust fixture tests, fixture/result verifiers and device launcher output consumers
verification_compatibility.removal_condition: Only with a versioned fixture/result/command migration; retain any still-supported historical reader.

retired_producer_rejection.reason: These exact retired names appear only as forbidden producer identities or negative naming cases, not supported routes.
retired_producer_rejection.reader: Resolved dependency and legacy-identifier regression tests
retired_producer_rejection.removal_condition: Retain while enforcing rejection; remove only when an equally strong replacement guard covers the retired producer/name.

asset_provenance.reason: The existing generated asset author field records its source producer.
asset_provenance.reader: Native asset catalogs and source provenance review
asset_provenance.removal_condition: Only when the canonical asset producer changes and the native cohort is regenerated coherently.
